MailTransmitRequest.description: Request to transmit and store a mail

customerId.description: Customer identifier — used to scope this mail to a specific customer. Overridden by the customerId present in the JWT when a valid Bearer token is supplied.

customerName.description: Human-readable customer name (e.g. 'ESET Software s.r.o.'). Stored alongside customerId for UI display and search. Optional.

to.description: Recipient email address(es) - supports multiple addresses separated by comma or semicolon

parameters.description: Filter mails by tag. Repeat the param for AND semantics: 'tags=kaspersky&tags=india' returns mails carrying both tags
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Filter mails by createDate. Allows range queries (e.g., from a date: 'creationDate=1735686000000%3C', to a date: 'creationDate=%3C1735772400000', between two dates: 'creationDate=1735686000000%3C%3C1736463600000'). Accepts epoch millis or ISO 'yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'

parameters.description: Filter mails by updateDate. Same range syntax as creationDate
